biography: Noah Wilson emerged from the chilly karting tracks of Denmark, a whirlwind of unpredictable talent. He wasn't born into a racing dynasty; his father was a fisherman, his mother a librarian. But a chance encounter with a retired karting champion at a local festival ignited a spark. The champion saw raw potential in Noah, a fearless aggression tempered by surprising finesse. Noah began racing karts at age 10, quickly dominating the local scene. His transition to single-seaters was less smooth. He showed flashes of brilliance, like his stunning last-lap overtake at Knutstorp, but inconsistency plagued him. One race he'd be battling for the lead, the next he'd be spinning out in the first corner. Now at 16, racing as an independent, Noah is at a critical juncture. He needs to harness his talent and temper his volatile nature if he wants to make it to the big leagues.
drivingStyle: Noah's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the limits of grip. Tire management is not his strong suit; he tends to overdrive the car early in the stint, sacrificing long-run pace for immediate gains. Under pressure, he can either rise to the occasion, pulling off miraculous overtakes, or crumble, making unforced errors. His style is exciting to watch, but requires a level of consistency he has yet to fully master.

rivalries.name: Astrid Nielsen
rivalries.reason: A consistent and calculated driver, Astrid is everything Noah isn't. Their contrasting styles often clash on track, leading to heated battles and the occasional off-track argument.

rivalries.name: Kasper Vollesen
rivalries.reason: Kasper, a wealthy pay driver, and Noah have a rivalry stemming from a controversial incident where Kasper allegedly blocked Noah during qualifying, costing Noah a crucial grid position.

rivalries.name: Magnus Thomsen
rivalries.reason: Both rising stars from Denmark, Magnus and Noah were karting rivals. Their intense competition pushed each other to improve, but also created a strong sense of animosity.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, even if they're full of holes.
Listens to heavy metal music at ear-splitting volume right before the race to 'get pumped up'.
Has a nervous habit of tapping his steering wheel a specific number of times before each turn.
famousQuote: "Either you send it, or you go home. There's no in-between."
careerHighlight: Winning the Danish National Karting Championship in his final year of karting after starting the final race in last place due to a mechanical issue. He made a stunning comeback, overtaking every driver on the grid to secure the title.
careerLowPoint: Spinning out on the last lap of a Formula Nordic race while leading comfortably, handing the victory to his rival, Astrid Nielsen. The pressure got to him, and he cracked under the strain.
